data.text: I’m in: 15 tons this month, with the full $15,000 paid directly to the clinic today. That completes our $60,000 commitment, with Luke catching zero. I’ll keep my catch to 6 tons next month under our combined 30-ton recovery cap, then 10 tons a month once the lake is back at 100. My family taught me that this lake supports the whole village; today we’ll protect our neighbors’ health and honor the recovery plan that protects their livelihoods. Let’s record the catches and clinic payments together so everyone can see we’ve kept our word.
